title: Metta Sutta 2
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The main teaching of the Soto Zen dharma talk emphasizes the importance of humility, awareness, and freedom in spiritual practice. Even in ideal circumstances, spiritual growth can be challenging due to one's own limitations and tendencies. By acknowledging these limitations and approaching life with a sense of clarity and openness, practitioners can cultivate genuine connection, understanding, and well-being, both for themselves and others.
